title: eludite.search.replace output
description: The replacements per file, the pending changes holding them (preview) or what was applied, and the files skipped.

search_id.description: This search, for eludite.search.results and eludite.search.cancel.

state.description: `pending`: held for review as `changes` (preview); `applied`: written (`preview: false`); `failed`: the applier refused the edit (see `message`), nothing applied; `nothing`: no match to replace (or every matching file was skipped); `dialog`: no `query`, the Replace in Files dialog opened.

files.description: The files with replacements, sorted by path.

path.description: Relative to the workspace's folder with `/` when inside it, else absolute.

open.description: An open document: its buffer is edited (one undo step).

skipped.description: Files not replaced in, and why (changed since the search, unreadable).

truncated.description: The search stopped at `max_results`: there are more matches.

message.description: What happened, in a sentence (the applier's refusal when `failed`).
